reviewContext.issueReference: none (no GitHub issue); opus-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-883, continuing session 868; source of truth is the workflow requestedOutcome, design-docs/specs/design-ai-capture.md revision 4 (amended CAP-R4-07 to CAP-R4-10) and impl-plans/active/capture-23-wiring.md, capture-16-docs-final.md
reviewContext.userProblem: Finish the nodetto AI capture feature on feat/ai-capture so an AI agent can capture any page as PNG or JPG, and a 3D CAD page from a chosen camera with interference visible as a hatched overlay and reported as text. e883b4b landed M10, M20, M22, M17, M18, M11, M12, M14 and M15 (accepted, not redone). M23 wiring is partly applied and M16 remains.
requiredOutcomes: M23: the picture pass uses tool_view with first-tool classification, admission before allocation (exact work, entry limit 4,194,304, tile-major storage), O(1) liveness spans, an in-fold boundary-scan allowance of 16e9 with bounded overshoot, overlay and hatch agreeing with the text, a 45% reference mix and the census (24M budget when interference is off). The CLI options, text, JSON and exit codes follow design 4.1, 4.2 and 12. The desktop handler accepts interference: null. All crate, CLI, desktop and native parity tests pass (design 6.7, 8.5, 10.2, CAP-R4-06 to CAP-R4-10).

M16: docs/capture.md and docs/cli.md let an agent discover capture unprompted; measured budgets and deviations are recorded in the design; the overview progress table marks every milestone accepted; all three final gates exit 0 with logs and native parity evidence.
Existing export behavior and documents keep working; captures stay deterministic; all commits are local on feat/ai-capture.
nonGoals: Redoing accepted milestones M1 to M15, M17 to M20 and M22.
cad3d M21 and cad3d M18; edits of cad3d design or plan files; README.md edits.
Design sections 2.3 and 2.4; any nodetto-cloud, server, auth, secret or deployment code.
Edits of census.rs, lattice.rs, interference.rs, interval.rs, overlay.rs, prism.rs or the TypeScript capture core.
constraints: Workers edit only their writePaths and their own plan file Progress section. No git state changes, no stash, branches or worktrees; never push.
English only, no emojis, strict TypeScript without any; cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true and CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/capture-<mNN>; format only owned files.
crates/capture: forbid(unsafe_code), no panic on any input, only + - * / and sqrt on geometry, dependencies only png and jpeg-encoder. Heavy or timed tests are release only.
Existing tests and deadlines are never weakened except the four pre-authorized M23 changes; timing tests may be retried up to three attempts, then run in isolation, all logged.
Theme tokens only; own fixtures with neutral names; no new dependency.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: One wiring plan followed by M16 (no wiring split).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The native parity gate exercises the crate picture pass and the CLI wiring together; a split would leave parity failures without a write owner, which is how session 868 blocked. Step 3 accepted this decision.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: CAP-R4-07: M23 owns tmp/capture (the parity gate runs the M9 test that writes tmp/capture/m09/timing.json) and the optional interference option of captureCadImage in export-handlers.ts; M16 owns tmp.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Resolves both session-868 blockers; design 8.5 requires the desktop interference: null case; no dialog control (live desktop interference is out of scope, 2.3).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: CAP-R4-08: M23 owns tiles.rs for admission before allocation, an entry limit and tile-major storage; public build, steps, work and the M12 tests are unchanged.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: TileLists allocated 737M entries for a valid refused scene and 5.9 GB of per-body offsets for an admitted sparse scene.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: CAP-R4-09: first-tool open classification for picture, report, census and analysis; the census budget is 24M when interference is off; tools are classified once in setup.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Removes false sampled-empty errors and lost solid pixels, keeps the section 12 promise, and removes the per-sample closure check.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: CAP-R4-10: O(1) liveness spans; an in-fold boundary-scan allowance of 16e9 with overshoot at most allowance + workers x 2^20 and a fixed refusal message.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Bounds the two picture costs that the admission limits did not count, deterministically for every worker count.

intentionalTradeoffs: M23 replaces the render.rs pixel digest and the three superseded assertions, regenerates capture-plate-default.ncs1 and updates the M9 [not in the picture] expectation, exactly as design 8.5 authorizes.
M16 gates may hit the Foundation atomic-write denials recorded at M10 (exit 101); these stay failures and are retried and logged, never counted as passing.
supportedEdgeCases: Open first tool: surface only, no census, no pairs. Later open operand: union and difference unchanged, intersection empties.
Scenes above the work, entry or boundary-scan limits are refused with exit 2 and fixed messages, identically for every worker count.
--no-interference still reports emptied bodies (24M census budget).
Desktop interference absent means DEFAULT_CAD_INTERFERENCE (options 3); null means options 0.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Perspective projection, wireframe capture and PCB board tool behavior (cad3d M18, M21).
Cloud document capture and server-side rendering (design 14).

acceptanceCriteria: Picture, report, census and interference eligibility use one first-tool classification computed once per tool in setup; a later open operand keeps material for union and difference and empties it for intersection; open-source bodies get no census error and no pair (design 6.7, CAP-R4-09).

Scenes are admitted before allocation (exact work equal to TileLists::work, entry limit 4,194,304) with tile-major storage and per-tile body visits; liveness costs O(1) per listed step; boundary reads are checked inside the fold with at most allowance + workers x 1,048,576 executed reads; refusals exit 2 with the fixed messages, identically for 1, 2 and 5 workers (design 10.2, CAP-R4-08, CAP-R4-10).
The census uses a 24M ray budget when interference is off; overlay marks agree with the report text; reference bodies mix at 45%; JSON keys unchanged; bytes equal across thread counts.

nodetto-cli capture accepts the interference options for CAD pages only, prints the body line, errors and interference lines, adds the JSON forms and uses interferenceExitCode; captureCadImage accepts interference: null (options 0) and defaults to options 3.

The restored test inventory in the plan's Tests section passes. It covers: tests/overlay.rs (including the no-overlay regression, the 100-seeded-scene agreement test, the 28-comparison bound and 1/2/5-thread equality); the M18 census cases end to end; the M11 mesh cases; the scale all-steps reference comparisons and refusals; the CAP-R4-06 mesh.rs unit tests; the capture-cad.test.ts fake-backend cases (the same approximate pair in text and JSON, uncheckedCount 25 with twenty listed, exit codes 1/1/0/0, body notes, fixture and mesh-only equality, options 0/3); and the full native parity list.

Every case of design 8.5 'M23 acceptance additions' passes, including the exact 53,692,800-read count and the costly-row refusal with 5 started workers; the 20,000-intersection, 200,000-triangle and M9 deadlines pass unchanged; engine_tests.rs is unedited; native parity passes with no skip.
